entries.zh: 楦开：把鞋撑开撑大（用鞋楦撑鞋，使鞋型张开）
entries.en: to stretch a shoe open; to shape or widen shoes (on a last)
entries.notes: H「桊」当为「楦」之形讹（撑鞋楦头）；M 音写 hûn 正合闽南「楦 hùn」，L ahormar（horma 楦头）即以楦整鞋。

entries.zh: 楦鞋：给鞋楦型、撑整鞋子使其合脚
entries.en: to shape or last shoes; to fit shoes on a last
entries.notes: 同上条：「桊」通「楦」，M 音写 hûn ē 即闽南「楦鞋」。

entries.zh: 节省开支；敛省（省俭用度、节制花费）
entries.en: to save on expenses; to spend moderately, economize

entries.zh: 退煞：驱邪赶鬼，逐走恶鬼凶煞；即念咒行法驱邪
entries.en: to drive away the devil; to exorcise, conjure him away
entries.notes: H「捫煞」与 M 音写 tě soá 不合，对音当为闽南「退煞」（驱邪逐煞语），「捫」疑「退」之形讹，故降为中置信。

entries.en: a head of garlic; a whole garlic bulb

entries.zh: 搬嫁妆：备办、搬送陪嫁财物；嫁妆、妆奁
entries.en: dowry, trousseau; household goods brought in marriage (to move the dowry)

entries.zh: 合：使两物相合、凑合对拢
entries.en: to fit or join two things together; to make them meet

entries.zh: 插插：把窗扇插闩关合（关上两扇窗）
entries.en: to shut or bar (two) windows; to fit the window shutters closed
entries.notes: M/R 音写 ba ba 与 H「插」音不协，本字存疑；释义依 L「ajustar ventanas」（关合窗扉）与 H「插」（插闩）取关窗义。

entries.zh: 算湊：凑算、结算账目以便偿付
entries.en: to reckon up and settle accounts in order to pay
